testcase.name: MIG-001 baseline applies once, records bytes, and doctor accepts it
MIG-002 rejects changed, missing, malformed, and linked SQL files before mutation
MIG-003 rolls back a pending batch and rejects transaction controls
MIG-004 serializes runners, restores role, times out on lock, and rejects wrong identity
MIG-005 requires current migrations, repeats an idempotent seed, and rolls back a batch
READY-008 a provisioned database without migrations answers 200 with 0 applied migrations
READY-008 after migrate.ts the count equals the number of database/migrations/*.sql files
READY-008 a 400 for ?x=1 on an idle backend does not make the next valid request 429
READY-008 countAppliedMigrations keeps the statement limit inside its transaction, so the pool session default stays as it was
READY-008 under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, 50 concurrent requests give one 503 under 5,000 ms and 49 busy answers
READY-008 a real 57014 error that arrives after a short deadline gives one unavailable, stays busy until it arrives, and stays silent
READY-008 a revoked SELECT gives 503 and GRANT restores 200
READY-008 a paused container gives 503 at the 5,000 ms deadline, 429 until the late query ends, and 200 within 15 s after unpause
READY-008 a stopped container gives 503 while /api/status stays 200, and after docker start a request succeeds within 30 s
READY-008 SIGTERM while a check waits on a paused database stops a backend within 3 s with exit code 0, Backend stopped, and empty stderr
READY-008 the route only reads: the migration history stays the same, and the backend role holds no write privilege on it
READY-008 responses and backend output carry no credential or database detail, and stderr stays empty
DEP-009 a provisioned database without migrations answers 503 and migrationApplied gives false
DEP-009 the migration name goes in as a parameter: a name with quotes gives false, not an error
DEP-009 SET LOCAL keeps the 2 s statement limit inside the transaction, so SHOW statement_timeout on the pool connection stays the same
DEP-009 after migrate.ts the same app answers 200 {"status":"ready"} without a restart
DEP-009 while common.schema_migrations is missing the answer is 503, and 200 once it is back
DEP-009 a revoked SELECT gives 503 and GRANT restores 200
DEP-009 a frozen container answers 503 within 5,500 ms, stays 503 for more than 5,000 ms with one real query call, then 200 within 15 s after unpause
DEP-009 no answer carries a credential, a time, a count, a name, or database detail

DATA-004 lock timeout leaves existing state intact

BKP-002 without the backup role and without FOUNDATION_BACKUP_PASSWORD provisioning prints exactly the report from before spec 0013
BKP-002 a valid FOUNDATION_BACKUP_PASSWORD creates foundation_backup with its pg_read_all_data membership, CONNECT only, and search_path
BKP-002 an existing foundation_backup is verified without the variable or with a valid password, and its password is never replaced
BKP-002 foundation_backup reads only through SET ROLE pg_read_all_data, cannot write, create, or take another role, and the runner still passes verifyIdentity
BKP-002 an empty or short FOUNDATION_BACKUP_PASSWORD fails while the role exists, without a change
BKP-002 INHERIT, BYPASSRLS, CREATEDB, or NOLOGIN on foundation_backup fails Role drift: foundation_backup without a change
BKP-002 SUPERUSER, CREATEROLE, or REPLICATION on foundation_backup fails Role drift: foundation_backup without a change
BKP-002 an extra membership or a changed pg_read_all_data option fails Role membership drift without a change
BKP-002 a role holding membership in foundation_backup, a runtime role or one outside the matrix, fails Role membership drift without a change
BKP-002 a missing pg_read_all_data membership is created again
BKP-002 CREATE or TEMPORARY on the database for foundation_backup is repaired to CONNECT only
BKP-002 CONNECT with grant option for foundation_backup fails Grant option drift without a change
BKP-002 a direct grant to foundation_backup on public, common, users, auth, or common.schema_migrations fails Unknown privilege drift without a change
BKP-002 a changed or removed search_path of foundation_backup is repaired

BKP-003 create manual through the Compose service backup leaves exactly three 0600 files with a valid checksum, a one line manifest, the source tables in the archive, and no secret in the dump
BKP-003 create scheduled and create pre-migration each leave one complete backup whose name, createdAt, and reason carry the reason and the UTC start time, in 0600 files of the container user
BKP-003 a backup role password with every reserved URI character, percent encoded in the DSN, authenticates, because the script decodes it as libpq does before it leaves the arguments

BKP-005 target_not_provisioned: restore into a new cluster without provisioning fails Restore target not provisioned and changes nothing
BKP-005 restore_failed: pg_restore failing after every check passed rolls back the single transaction and leaves the target empty
BKP-004 restore through the Compose service restore into the provisioned empty target gives the same data, history, and readiness 200, and the source passwords fail there

BKP-007 create manual in a folder of aged backups keeps the 7 newest, removes complete backups older than 35 days and leftovers older than 24 hours in the order of *Retensi*, touches nothing else, and check then reports the new backup 0 h old

BKP-007 retention reads the mtime of a .partial, keeps leftovers up to 24 hours and backups past 35 days within the newest 7, and never removes or prints a symlink, a subfolder, a .partial whose name create never writes, or another file
BKP-007 check reports the newest complete backup: the folder rules first, then the checksum before the age, and at most 26 hours
BKP-007 check counts only complete backups of three regular files with a name of the pattern: incomplete sets, a .partial, a set with a symlinked manifest, and another reason give No backup found

BKP-007 a backup name whose stamp is not a valid date stops retention with Retention failed after Backup created, keeps the new backup complete, removes nothing, and fails check with Backup failed: internal

BKP-004 the fingerprint lists tables and sequences from the catalog, a new schema and quoted names included and partitions left out, and keeps every digest under other session settings of the backup role
